# Ticket Workspace

## Summary
The agent's working view of one ticket: header slab with pickers for assignee, queue, category and policy, SLA badges, the conversation feed with reply composer, status transitions, escalation, merge and knowledge-article suggestions — every action routed through the cluster's commands.

## API
Args: `ticket?`, `context?`, `realms?`, `onLeftQueue?()` (called when the ticket leaves the list the reader is working). A Glimmer component, not a card format, because its interactive state cannot live inside `static isolated = class`.

## Usage
```ts
import { TicketWorkspace } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/components/ticket-workspace';

<TicketWorkspace @ticket={{this.selected}} @context={{@context}} @realms={{this.realms}} @onLeftQueue={{this.clearSelection}} />
```
Lazily imports Service Request and its approval command so a console without approvals never loads them.

## Non-goals
Not the queue list beside it and not a card; consumers place it in their own console layout.
